date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD; assume the year 2026 when the text gives none

amount.description: total claimed, in the original currency, without the currency symbol

attendees.description: people covered by a meal claim, including the submitter; null if not a meal

nights.description: hotel nights; null if not lodging

cabin.description: flight cabin; null if not airfare

alcohol_amount.description: amount spent on alcohol in the original currency, 0 if none

confidence.description: how sure you are that every field above is stated in the text rather than guessed
